title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
title_zh: BLIP-Live：平衡主动式流视频智能体的响应及时性与触发精确率
abstract_en: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.
abstract_zh: 主动式流视频智能体需要在证据充分时尽快回应，同时避免过早、重复或错误地回应。BLIP-Live 将主动性定义为仅依据当前及历史信息决定何时回应、何时保持沉默，并围绕这一决策统一了数据、评测、推理与训练。作者构建了 BLIP-Live-780K 数据集，由人工标注回应内容与时机，并提出 PAUC-F 指标，将响应及时性与触发精确率结合，奖励及时且有用的回应，而不鼓励频繁触发。作者还探索了不依赖特定模型的推理框架，使离线视觉语言模型（VLM）具备主动处理流视频的能力，并通过训练进一步改善响应决策。在推理与训练两种设置中，结合滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆和结构化响应输出的方案表现最佳。BLIP-Live-Qwen 在四个主动式流视频基准上达到最先进水平，较基线最高提升 44%，并超越多个闭源 API 模型。作者计划公开代码和数据。
key_points_zh: BLIP-Live-780K 同时标注「何时回应」和「回应什么」，为主动响应提供监督。
PAUC-F 联合衡量响应及时性与触发精确率，避免模型仅靠频繁回应获得高分。
滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆与结构化输出的组合，在推理和训练两种设置中均表现最佳。
BLIP-Live-Qwen 在四个主动式流视频基准上达到最先进水平，较基线最高提升 44%，并超过多个闭源 API 模型。

agent-multimodal.quote:
At each streaming timestep t, the harness constructs an input from a system
prompt (task and output schema), a rolling past-frame window, and memory of user queries and prior responses.
A frozen offline VLM is queried at the target frame rate; structured output is parsed into either silence or a
response at t, and accepted responses are updated into memory.
